questionReview.note: Both complete Q1 alternatives correspond and are retained: A sole-trader profit/loss 75 and balance sheet 45; B manufacturing 40, trading/profit/loss 35 and balance sheet 45. Paper 2–5 and scheme 3–9 match. Q1A mortgage working uses 2,875 although the trial balance prints 2,375; the original scheme figures are retained. The outer A/B choice does not remove either route.
The full 60-mark tabular statement corresponds on paper 6–7 and scheme 10. All dated transactions are required. Irish scheme 10 is upright landscape, matching the English treatment.
All three vehicle ledgers for both 2019 and 2020 and the shared depreciation explanation/profit-loss extract correspond: 6/32/14/8. Paper 8 and scheme 11–12. Neither year or disposal is optional.
Debtors control 22, corrected schedule 30 and control-account importance 8 correspond on paper 9 and scheme 13, including all six error scenarios.

Five calculations (12/10/10/10/8), shareholder report 40 and shared gearing theory 10 correspond on paper 10–11 and scheme 14–17. Two ways to reduce gearing are open responses. The report contains source wording errors, including a low-gearing description inconsistent with the calculated high gearing and a previous-year reference; no additional task results.

Published profit/loss 40, balance sheet 26, all five notes together 24 and shared exceptional-item/qualified-audit theory 10 correspond on paper 12–13 and scheme 18–21. The balance-sheet total presentation and its red marking annotation are retained in the original scheme.

Abridged profit/loss 18, operating reconciliation 17, cash-flow statement 46, net-debt reconciliation 7 and shared theory 12 correspond on paper 14–15 and scheme 22–25. The paper provision rises from 2,000 to 5,400; the scheme labels it a decrease while adding 3,400. These are original source labels, not extra answer routes.

FIFO closing stock 16 and trading account 14, three required departmental rates at 2 each and job price 28, three further absorption rates at 2 each and combined over/under-absorption explanation 10 correspond on paper 16–17 and scheme 26–27. All departments are mandatory; no internal choice.

Both high/low calculations at 14, 90% flexible budget 16, both investment-option budgets at 12 each, recommendation 2 and shared theory 10 correspond on paper 18 and scheme 28–31. The word options refers to two mandatory business scenarios, not a choose-one exam route. Scheme 32 is the Irish-bonus table; 33–35 blank and 36 cover.
